exact_missing_items: Seams: allow browsing, but gate actions that depend on current promotion/blocker truth
Node Graph: keep historical graph and current selections visible, but flag when live node state may be stale
Evidence: artifact browsing can remain available; live verdict/action affordances may gate
History / Ledger: usually the fallback-safe surfaces because they are closest to canonical records
Cross-tab navigation is a design contract: deep-links with selection/filter/focus context must work across all 6 Orchestrator tabs

Concern user actions must include: open/focus, open evidence, open history, open ledger, acknowledge (where allowed), dismiss (where allowed), open resolution thread, approve/reject at HITL boundaries
All blocked states must expose: reason, owner, time blocked, and next step — these 4 fields are mandatory in every blocked-state display
Action-gating under stale projections: execution/promotion/recovery/approval actions require fresh-enough projection; the UI must explain gating inline, not silently block
Alert levels must be exactly: Info, Warning, Attention, Action Required — this is a closed four-level taxonomy
Alert state semantics: 'resolved' means the underlying condition changed; 'dismissed' means presentation hidden only; blockers must NOT be dismissible
gap_candidates.blocking_reason: Coverage row indicates incomplete or missing canon alignment for concrete target.
